_comment: W6+SH probe rung 2 — the PHASE DATUM hypothesis.
Probe rung 1 (_simnet50_wsh_probe) withheld 19/19 with the posture bundle 3/3
ARMED, so the documented 50-station withhold is NOT the elevation-cutoff
artifact.  Its estimability dump names the culprit exactly: ONE extra near-null
beyond the declared clock gauge, ev 9.78e-06 (gauge 6.9e-12, next real layer
2.48e-02), composed as a UNIFORM PB|*|L2W direction — the secondary-band
satellite phase-bias COMMON MODE, stable to four digits across epochs.
With float ambiguities that direction is absorbable by the L2W ambiguities, so
it is a GAUGE the declared dimension (= #constellations = 1) does not count.
The in-flight field arm (_cbq305_2f_12h_d10) does NOT run the legacy phase
datum that rung 1 ran: it runs network.phase_datum_eq34 (+ min_stations 1).
That is the Odijk-Eq-34 single-receiver-chain phase datum, i.e. a different
and more complete pinning of exactly the phase-bias family this near-null
lives in.  If the wall is the DATUM rather than station support, this rung
emits at 50 stations and the whole ladder collapses to a cheap fixture.
